agent_subject: Named current agent; each Cash-In/Cash-Out or assisted W2W contributes one service using explicit serviced_wallet, including receiver-serviced W2W.
baseline: B_L(H,T)={e in prior H: t-L-28d<time(e)<=t-L}. Excludes current and all recent events.
cold_start: Baseline-ineligible family evaluates false, with eligible=false and reason recorded in diagnostics. Other eligible families may still make y=1. Recent-only descriptors remain valid; baseline-dependent descriptors emit their declared marker.
coverage: Eligibility requires first prior observed wallet participation or agent service <= baseline lower boundary, plus family-specific baseline counts. Private activation is never coverage. First observation exactly at lower boundary establishes observation age but is excluded from an open-lower baseline count.
day_exception: UTC calendar S3: recent [d,t] restricted by prior keys plus current; baseline [d-28d,d), d=UTC midnight. Its28 daily bins are [d-k*1day,d-(k-1)*1day), k=1..28. This half-open calendar exception is explicit.
forbidden_sharing: predicate-specific eligibility flags as model inputs
history_retention: Keep last 35d event state plus first-observed timestamp. Calendar S3 never needs more than 29d before current. Full raw ledger retained separately.
numeric: Amounts, sums, counts and predicate comparisons use integers/rationals; no floating-point threshold tolerance. Features may use float64 after exact aggregation. Median includes empty buckets; even median averages the two central values. Floors explicitly defined per formula.
ordering: key=(UTC timestamp at integer microsecond precision, integer transaction_id); process increasing key; require unique IDs.
prior: Only key(e)<key(T). Same-time smaller IDs are prior; same-time larger IDs are future. Emit all targets/features before state update.
recent: R_L(H,T)={e in prior H: t-L<time(e)<=t}, plus T once only for the current role listed by each predicate/feature.
status: DESIGN_ONLY; implementation and population evidence pending
wallet_subject: Current sender for W2W; serviced_wallet for cash. Structuring activity contains prior W2W sent by subject and prior Cash-In/Cash-Out of subject, once per event. Incoming W2W establishes wallet observation age and inflow history, but is not structuring activity.
